title: Right part of a code segment
statement: Let $P$ be a list of instructions, and suppose $l_1\mathbin{++}l_2$ is a prefix of the part of $P$ beginning at position $\mathrm{pos}$. Then $l_2$ is a prefix of the part beginning at position $\mathrm{pos}+|l_1|$, where $|l_1|$ is the length of $l_1$.
hypotheses_covered: The concatenation $l_1\mathbin{++}l_2$ is a prefix of the list obtained by dropping the first $\mathrm{pos}$ instructions of $P$
